evidence: Comenius, Orbis pictus 128: Chīrūrgus cūrat vulnera et ulcera splēniīs
terms.comment: Traupman has only taenia adhaesīva, adhesive tape (268), and M-O gives no Latin for plaster, so “band-aid” is our application of splēnium.

phrases.latin: Vīsne splēnium? Ecce, jam melius est.
phrases.english: Do you want a plaster? There, that’s better already.

sources: Lewis & Short: splenium · Lewis & Short: emplastrum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 268.
Comenius from the Latinitas loci collection (loci-comenius).
